scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
authority: The stated new user instruction permits this diagnostic exception to prior quiescence requirements. Active cleanup mutation rights remain unchanged.

prior_transients.disposition: Record the diagnostic and subsequent control transient explicitly. Preserve any resulting census refusal; infer no physical clearance.

eligible_reader.identity: Emit actual self PID and start ticks before accepting requests; retain that identity with every response.
eligible_reader.transport: Existing tool stdin for explicit requests; stdout only for results.

required_restrictions: Freeze the exact absolute initial allowlist, including the launcher state path, before launch. Reject unlisted paths, relative paths, wildcards and unknown request operations.

Use O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK, then verify an allowed regular or specifically selected proc file before reading. O_NONBLOCK avoids blocking during open if a fixed pathname has become a FIFO.
Enforce at most16 paths per request,131072 bytes per file and1048576 total bytes read per request. Separately bound serialized responses, including encoding and metadata.
Report truncation explicitly. Never parse a truncated release, source or state record as complete authority; never silently bypass the per-file cap.
Record fstat before and after with exact integers. Live captures and proc files may change; report changes without asserting a coherent snapshot or retrying.

Permit proc reads only for self, the two recorded PID/start identities, or genuinely derived current helper/engine/holder ancestry. Bind derived PID/start identities and concrete relationship evidence; maximum depth4 and16 PIDs. No enumeration of /proc.
Verify recorded or derived start ticks around proc observations; report disappearance, reuse or inconsistent lineage without following a replacement process.
Bind the exact journal pathname through a separate explicit request only after deriving it from sufficient retained current source/release evidence. No directory traversal or discovery walk.
Require explicit finite requests. No automatic polling, retries, fallback paths, source imports or execution of captured code.
Report failures as observations; do not alter owner state, locks, release files, containers or guest state.
limitations: This accepts the protocol subject to implementation of these restrictions; no exact reader source or command bytes were supplied for verification.
The exception does not make the unchanged engine census accept the reader. Any refusal remains genuine evidence.
Diagnostic reads establish no cleanup completion, internal cause, recovery authority or physical clearance.
